tools.name: king_county_permit_status
tools.description: Look up building permit history and status for any King County, WA property. Accepts a street address, 10-digit parcel number, or permit number. Live sources: MyBuildingPermit (14 cities + unincorporated King County), Seattle and Bellevue open data, Renton EnerGov, Redmond Civic Access, Shoreline eT

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "king_county_permit_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
